name: Craftsman Industrial 009-26004: Craftsman 6-Piece Router Bit Sets
description: Craftsman Industrial 009-26004: Router Bits, 6-piece, Carbide, Steel Shanks, Storage Case, Set - Get a jump-start on your router bit collection with one of these Craftsman 6-piece router bit sets. Whether you're just starting out with your router or replacing old bits, they're ideal for the woodworker who appreciates variety. The sets include six bits in five of the most popular shapes for edges and decorative detailing. Be ready to jump into sign-making, custom household wood trim, or putting a professional finish on all manner of wood furniture! Each piece in the Craftsman 6-piece router bit sets benefits from high-quality Craftsman construction, with heat-treated steel alloy bodies and tough carbide heads. The 1/4 in. shank diameter on each bit fits all Craftsman routers, as well as most other standard handheld or bench routers. A convenient wooden storage box keeps the bits organized in their own custom slot.
